title: proofrecord-aar-interop v0.1.0-rc.4: signed ProofRecord and Agent Action Receipts (AAR) interoperability demonstration
description:
Synthetic, offline-verifiable demonstration that an Agent Action Receipts (AAR) bundle cites an Ed25519-signed ExecutionProof ProofRecord and records exactly the action that record authorized (action, target, parameter bytes, actor credential, validity window, single use).

Includes an offline verifier (Python standard library plus PyNaCl/libsodium for Ed25519), positive and negative fixtures, 97 targeted tests, and a reproducible observation of 16 AAR-conformant bundles that disagree with the ProofRecord.

Limitations: same-author results, not independent validation; not formal AAR conformance and not endorsed by AAR; synthetic test key only; signing-key misuse (T18) not prevented; cross-bundle replay not tested.
notes: Release candidate. License: MIT for RF-authored files; third-party files keep their own licenses (Apache-2.0 AAR fixtures). No third-party code is bundled; Ed25519 verification uses the PyNaCl runtime dependency (Apache-2.0, bundling libsodium under ISC). See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the archive.
